name: Wit of the Heartless Streets
body:
School necromancy; Level: jester 8

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Close (95 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius burst
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will special; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Each target takes 2d6 points of phrenic damage +1 point per caster level, and 10 ongoing phrenic damage (requires a successful saving throw at the beginning of each of the opponent’s turns to end). Until the end of combat, you gain a +4 bonus to attacks with flanking bonus instead of the normal +2 bonus.
